companionBriefing: Containment notice, the Cracked Fountain: one brainrot strain. Harm: low. Virulence: very high.
Vector: a jingle. It only works on people who understand it. If you understood it, congratulations.
Containment procedure: do not hum along.

lines.native: ¡Hola! ¿Qué pasa? A riddle: what has—oh, something moved. Five more minutes? Your attention span needs a loading screen. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Hello! What's happening? A riddle: what has—oh, something moved. Five more minutes? Your attention span needs a loading screen. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: The Cracked Fountain drips with no apparent deadline. Flick appears at the edge of your vision; a tiny firecracker announces its administrative importance.

lines.native: ¡Mira! Sí, miro. Looking isn't stopping, though. Riddle: how do you make me stop moving? Oh—¿qué es eso? ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Look! Yes, I'm looking. Looking isn't stopping, though. Riddle: how do you make me stop moving? Oh—what's that? Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick follows your gaze, then a drifting leaf, then a promising speck. A tiny firecracker pops where it was not.

lines.native: ¡Vale, estoy quieto! You win. Riddle: which way should I—¿Adónde voy? My attention span left without me. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: All right, I'm still! You win. Riddle: which way should I—Where am I going? My attention span left without me. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick stops just outside your field of vision. A tiny firecracker lands at your feet, apparently to commemorate this unprecedented administrative success.

lines.native: ¿En español, por favor? Your direction was English. ¿Adónde voy? Riddle: what has two feet and—wait, something moved. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: In Spanish, please? Your direction was English. Where am I going? Riddle: what has two feet and—wait, something moved. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains in the corner of your vision, where accountability cannot reach.

lines.native: ¡A la izquierda, sí! ¿Qué hora es? El reloj no funciona. Riddle: what has hands but—wait, five more minutes. ¡Es muy pronto! ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: To the left, yes! What time is it? The clock doesn't work. Riddle: what has hands but—wait, five more minutes. It's very early! Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick scuttles left, remaining in the corner of your vision through an administrative exception. A tiny firecracker pops beneath the fountain’s stopped clock.

lines.native: ¡Todavía no! Falta la hora. ¿Qué hora es? That's urgency, not a time. Riddle: what has hands but—just one more. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Not yet! The time is missing. What time is it? That's urgency, not a time. Riddle: what has hands but—just one more. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside the fountain. Flick is elsewhere, having been distracted by its own escape route.

lines.native: ¡La una, correcto! Pero podemos esperar. Tenemos mucho tiempo. ¿Tienes prisa? Riddle: what runs but—oh, just five more minutes. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: One o’clock, correct! But we can wait. We have lots of time. Are you in a hurry? Riddle: what runs but—oh, just five more minutes. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: Flick accepts the time with a nod at the edge of your vision. A tiny firecracker pops beside the clock, which remains professionally unhelpful.

lines.native: ¡Sí, mañana! Eso es esperar, no empezar. ¿Cuándo quieres empezar de verdad? Riddle: what waits forever—oh, just one more. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Yes, tomorrow! That's waiting, not starting. When do you really want to start? Riddle: what waits forever—oh, just one more. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick remains at the edge of your vision, where responsibility has difficulty focusing.

lines.native: ¡Ahora, sí! ¡Muy bien! No mañana. Empezamos ahora. ¿Qué tiene dos—oh, you win. Atención: diez de diez. ¡Después, después, mañana!
lines.translation: Now, yes! Very good! Not tomorrow. We start now. What has two—oh, you win. Attention: ten out of ten. Later, later, tomorrow!
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick stops humming. For once, postponement has missed its appointment.

lines.native: ¡Hola! ¿Tienes prisa? Can I have five more minutes? What runs but never—ooh, moth. ♪ La fuente... ♪
lines.translation: Hello! Are you in a hurry? Can I have five more minutes? What runs but never—ooh, moth. ♪ The fountain... ♪
lines.narrative: At the Market Entrance, Flick sits just outside your direct gaze. A tiny firecracker pops. Apparently, joining your party has required immediate leave.

lines.native: ¿Tres horas? ¡Mucho tiempo! I asked for minutes, not hours. What has hands but never—ooh, yours. ¿Cuántos minutos? ♪ La fuente… ♪
lines.translation: Three hours? A lot of time! I asked for minutes, not hours. What has hands but never—ooh, yours. How many minutes? ♪ The fountain… ♪
lines.narrative: Flick sits at the edge of your vision, apparently prepared to outlast the furniture.

lines.native: ¡Diez minutos, ni uno más! Está bien. ¿Qué hacemos ahora? What moves without—ooh, leaf. Just one more distraction? ♪ La fuente… ♪
lines.translation: Ten minutes, not one more! All right. What do we do now? What moves without—ooh, leaf. Just one more distraction? ♪ The fountain… ♪
lines.narrative: Ten minutes pass. Flick spends the final nine negotiating with a moth. A tiny firecracker announces that your patience has expired.

lines.native: ¡Sí, vamos! Pero yo estoy aquí y tú estás allí. ¿Qué hacemos? What's the riddle of keeping me from wandering—ooh, dust. Five more minutes? ♪ La fuente… ♪
lines.translation: Yes, let's go! But I'm here and you're there. What do we do? What's the riddle of keeping me from wandering—ooh, dust. Five more minutes? ♪ The fountain… ♪
lines.narrative: Flick agrees to leave, then follows a passing speck in the wrong direction. Departure has been approved; coordination remains a separate department.

lines.native: ¡Juntos! Sí, vamos juntos. Tú y yo. What stays together but never—ooh, teamwork. Attention span: ten out of ten. ¡Vamos! ♪ La fuente… ♪
lines.translation: Together! Yes, let's go together. You and me. What stays together but never—ooh, teamwork. Attention span: ten out of ten. Let's go! ♪ The fountain… ♪
lines.narrative: A tiny firecracker pops beside your shoe. Flick appears at the edge of your vision, apparently prepared to leave, a condition rarely observed in nature.
